news.title: SBI Holdings' blockchain initiative pivots to Solana for tokenization, stablecoin issuance
news.summary: The SBI Solana Global joint venture now includes the Solana Foundation, the Swiss organization that oversees the layer-1 network.

news.title: Wall Street transfer agents lobby SEC, warning that third-party tokens pose risks to market integrity
news.summary: The Securities Transfer Association, an industry group for transfer agents, said company-authorized tokenization should receive preferential treatment under future rules.

news.title: Robinhood built a blockchain for tokenized stocks. Memecoins took over
news.summary: Robinhood Chain has pulled in $135 million of value and 800,000 addresses since July 1. Almost none of it is doing what the chain was built for.

news.title: Strategy pauses its Bitcoin buying spree to hoard a massive $3 billion cash cushion
news.summary: Strategy now has more than 20 months of coverage for preferred-stock dividends and debt interest.

news.title: Bitcoin panic-selling may be ending as sellers' profit margins disappear
news.summary: Analysts point to bitcoin’s resilience amid fresh U.S.-Iran escalation and renewed spot ETF inflows as the clearest signs yet that the marginal seller has stepped away.

news.title: Robinhood Chain surges into top five by DEX volume: Bernstein
news.summary: Robinhood's new blockchain quickly became a top-five network by DEX volume, signaling strong early demand for its tokenized asset platform, the broker said.

news.title: Micron and other chip stocks feel the pain of imported volatility — blame SK Hynix
news.summary: The SOX chip index was suffering a unanimous selloff, after SK Hynix’s stock had its worst day in 18 years in South Korea trading.

news.title: Can big banks’ ‘cheap’ stocks keep rising? We’ll find out when JPMorgan and an unusual number of others report earnings Tuesday
news.summary: Among the largest U.S. banks, Citigroup is expected to show the greatest improvement by one important measure. But it still has a long way to go to reach its own performance target.
